QuestInfo.name: Friend of the Monarch
QuestInfo.0: Your old friend, the Pegasus #p1033240#, is back. She's been through many hardships.
QuestInfo.1: After the Pegasus was set free from Elluel, she was hurt by the Black Mage. #p1033240# looks like she's starving. Give her some food.
QuestInfo.2: #p1033240# rested up. Even if you tried to send her away, she'd never leave your side again. Even if the Black Mage returned, she'd go into battle with you.

0.0: You look great, Mercedes. I guess getting frozen by the Black Mage was good for your complexion...\r\n#L0##bYou look tired, #p1033240#.#k Are you okay? Were you hurt?#l\n#k
0.1: No, no, I'm fine. It's just, Maple World has changed so much, and it's not really a good place for Unicorns anymore... I've just been getting by, since you Elves were all frozen and stuff...

yes.0: (#p1033240# seems very hungry. You should get her some food from the General Store. She used to love Elven cooking...)

1.0: This is... I haven't had this in ages! I missed this so much! We used to have so much fun, didn't we? But then you went off to fight the Black Mage, and left me all alone...\r\n#L0##bI promised you I'd return...#l\n#k
1.1: Yes, so I stayed in Maple World and waited for you and the Elves to come back. I knew you would, that someday we would gallop through the Victoria Island again.\r\n#L0##bNot yet. I can't rest until the Black Mage is gone for good. Please wait a little longer, #p1033240#.#l\n#k
1.2: No! I don't want to wait anymore, Mercedes!

yes.0: I promised myself I'd never let you go away again! You don't know how many times I circled the village, looking for a way to get in, waiting for you to come back.
yes.1: I should've gone with you to fight the Black Mage in the first place.
yes.2: I don't care if you're gonna fight the Black Mage again. You aren't getting rid of me! I'll go with you, no matter what!

item.0: (The General Store sells Unicorn Food. There used to be lots of Unicorns in the village, after all.)
